recent_news.headline: EREF Report Shows 10% Increase in U.S. Landfill Tipping Fees, Largest Increase Since 2022
recent_news.summary: EREF released their 2024 Analysis showing a 10% increase in U.S. landfill tipping fees to a national average of $62.28 per ton, with large landfills charging over $70. Private landfills charge about 34% more than public facilities.
